<includeonly>{{#ifexist:{{#var:mwv-page}}/{{{1}}}|{{{1}}},}}</includeonly><noinclude>
Use to add new versions to {{tl|mwv}} (see instructions given in source)
==Usage==
<pre>{{mwv/new|vVERSIONx}}</pre>
*<code>v</code> is required
*<code>VERSION</code> is the ''major version'' (e.g. <code>4</code>)
*<code>x</code> is the ''minor version'' (e.g. <code>a</code>), if it exists
</noinclude>
